three.js r186 (npm three@0.186.1), vendored 2026-10-21.

build/
  three.module.js       WebGL2 build (imported as "three")
  three.core.js         shared core (imported by three.module.js / three.webgpu.js)
  three.webgpu.js       WebGPURenderer + NodeMaterial + TSL runtime (imported as "three/webgpu")
  three.tsl.js          TSL shader functions (imported as "three/tsl", re-exports via three/webgpu)
  three.webgpu.nodes.js node-material build (reserved for the TSL post-chain port)

examples/jsm/
  geometries/ loaders/ postprocessing/ shaders/ utils/   full upstream dirs (r186)
  libs/meshopt_decoder.module.js                          only what GLTFLoader needs
  tsl/                        TSL display/pass nodes (BloomNode, GTAONode, …) for the
                              follow-up: porting the EffectComposer post-chain to RenderPipeline
